Generate a U-shaped profile by subtracting an offset rectangular box from a larger one, ensuring both ends remain open. The larger box should measure 450 mm in length, 70 mm in width, and 40 mm in height. Subtract an inner box that is 60 mm wide and 35 mm and high with same 450mm length, maintain a wall thickness of 5 mm around the sides and base, resulting in a U-shape, open at the top and sides | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step plan (NO function calls yet)

1. Establish the reference point  
   • Use the global origin (0 ,0 ,0) as the common basepoint for the outer profile.

2. Create the solid outer volume  
   • Generate one rectangular block with  
     – Length (X-size): 450 mm  
     – Width  (Y-size): 70 mm  
     – Height (Z-size): 40 mm  
     – Basepoint: (0 ,0 ,0)  
   • This is an additive block (subtraction = False) and gives the full solid bar.

3. Define the inner cavity to make the “U”  
   • The inner block must be inset 5 mm from every closed face (left, right and bottom) so that those walls stay 5 mm thick; the front and back faces (along the X-direction) stay completely open, so the inner cavity has the same 450 mm length.  
   • Therefore set the inner block parameters to  
     – Length (X-size): 450 mm (same as the outer)  
     – Width  (Y-size): 60 mm  (70 mm – 2 × 5 mm side walls)  
     – Height (Z-size): 35 mm  (40 mm – 5 mm bottom wall; the top stays open)  
     – Basepoint: (0 ,5 ,5)  
   • Mark this block as a subtraction (subtraction = True) so it removes material.

4. Execution order is important  
   • Call the block-creation function once with the two blocks listed in the correct order:  
     – First entry = outer block (subtraction False)  
     – Second entry = inner block (subtraction True)

5. Finish the geometry  
   • Once both blocks are created in the same function call, signal completion with the required finished-flag function (finished(allFunctionsCalled = True)).

This sequence yields a 450 mm long, 70 mm wide, 40 mm high U-shaped profile that has 5 mm-thick side and bottom walls, an open top, and open ends.
